links.outcome: Detection of abnormal CDS alert behavior via SPC frequency dashboard
links.effect: From June-August 2022, SPC-flagged alerts with greatest variation were investigated and found to be functioning correctly; variation reflected practice changes rather than system errors. Authors call it time-efficient and effective.
links.quote: The most profound abnormalities detected during implementation reflected changes in practice and not system errors, though further investigation into thresholds for statistical significance will benefit this field.

links.outcome: Identification of atypical alert-frequency variation through longitudinal monitoring
links.effect: June-August 2022: SPC visualizations enabled rapid review of alerts with greatest variation. Investigated alerts functioned correctly; major abnormalities reflected practice changes rather than system errors. No quantitative detection performance was reported.
links.quote: SPC-defined parameters for standard deviation from the mean were applied to visualizations and allowed for rapid review of alerts with greatest variation.

links.effect: SPC parameters on visualizations allowed for rapid review of alerts with the greatest variation.
links.quote: SPC-defined parameters for standard deviation from the mean were applied to visualizations and allowed for rapid review of alerts with greatest variation.
